comparison_boundaries: Original #29 uses the real frozen JavaScript Router and an injected fetchImpl. The native replay uses the real native Router plus an owned injected HttpTransport returning the captured /api/show bytes and a genuinely never-ready /v1/systemone body. Both preserve deadline=0 and a real 30 ms pending observation. No live Ollama instance or classifier output is substituted.

The source evaluator request exposes an AbortSignal and ReadableStream reader.cancel. Rust HttpTransport has no AbortSignal argument/property and represents response cancellation by dropping the owned body. The native replay observes the actual borrowed routing CancellationToken and actual evaluator-body destruction before Gateway.close. It does not claim source/native signal identity or expose the internal classifier child-token state. The source signal.aborted and bodyCancelled predicates are explicitly ported to these typed cancellation/lifetime observations.

The source caller rejects with an AbortError. The native caller-owned real socket task returns typed ClientFailure::Cancelled after actual caller cancellation and drops its socket. Other typed connect/write/unexpected-response errors cannot satisfy the native equivalent predicate. There is no string-name replacement, synthetic upstream response, or direct mutation of the Router cancellation token.

Gateway may destroy the routing waiter before its inner future returns. The raw native route_returned_cancelled flag remains false in this execution; actual token cancellation, evaluator body destruction and route future destruction are retained separately. No returned EvaluationError is fabricated.

All #32 clients are sequential, with the original statuses reset before each of {}, fallbacks:[], fallback_credit_token:PRIVATE_TOKEN and advisor_20260630. The clean #30 SSE end_turn completion carries exact observed model/continuation_model/stop_reason/tool-use evidence even though the source mocked complete returns undefined and native mocked complete returns false. Both expose completion_confirmed=true because response observation is clean. #31 HTTP429 and #32 JSON without stop_reason carry no evidence and remain unconfirmed. Real production continuation-state acceptance is outside these mocked routing callbacks.

Source mocked complete callbacks include redundant successful cleanup calls; native Gateway consumes each request lease once. All 13 source and 7 native calls remain in raw transcripts, including their actual return values. Callback identity/cardinality equality is not claimed.

Only measured first_response_ms and total_latency_ms lack equal-value timing comparison; presence and finite nonnegative values are verified. Actual generated UUIDs, HTTP Date values and separately bound loopback authorities differ and remain raw. The retained source projection ledger records exactly which source observations changed for stability.

Undefined source metadata corresponds to absent native fields; optional typed RouteOptions identifiers use empty strings. Numeric metadata compares actual numerical values corresponding to JavaScript Number equality, preserving raw f64/integer representation. No full body is truncated, removed or rewritten.

Original provider callbacks leave request streams unread. Passive source capture delegates IncomingMessage.push without reading or draining. The native bounded peer reads complete finite synthetic request bodies before responding; original unread-stream API/timing equivalence is not asserted.

independent_review.scope: Exact original callbacks/predicates and all source/native fragment hashes, original execution counts, actual cancellation/response/usage schedules and explicit typed API boundaries. Stream#26 stays partial pending returned-future replay; cancellation does not fabricate a resumed rejection.
